# Resonate Lighting

> Music-reactive pixel lighting kits for commercial spaces, Business Improvement Areas (BIAs) and municipalities in Canada, with installation anywhere in the country and lifetime access to the software that runs them. Based in Saskatchewan.

## What a kit is
- Light Show controller box: Raspberry Pi 5 running LedFx and Resonate's proprietary Light Show engine and app, in a weatherproof enclosure.
- USB microphone; the engine tracks background noise (quiet-room gate) so music looks only react to music.
- Pixel controller, power supplies and distribution (the app reads SanDevices E682 port settings).
- 12 V WS2811 props: mega trees, roofline runs, wrapped deciduous trees, evergreen spirals, pixel arches.
- Lifetime software access with updates; no subscription.

## The Light Show app
- Served by the controller over its own "Lightshow" Wi-Fi hotspot to any phone; no app store, no internet needed; admin password.
- 16 themes, 11 music looks (Power, Scroll, Ripple, Pulse, Piano, Flow, Lava, Beat Bars, Fire, Glow, Beat Flash), 8 steady looks, 10 colour schemes plus custom colours.
- Brightness, smoothness, speed, always-on glow, music sensitivity; saved looks; playlists; on/off schedules by day; MP3 playback from USB.
- Setup wizard: controller and port tests, microphone calibration, look check.

## Pricing (CAD, starting at, plus tax; installation extra)
Current figures are published at https://resonatelighting.com/pricing (packages: Starter Kit, Business Kit, Plaza / BIA Kit, Municipal Program). Installation is billed per crew-day plus travel by zone from Saskatchewan, with accommodation on multi-day jobs outside the home region.
